title: studio(nav editor): an untargeted "Add nav item" placeholder is sent on save and fails with a raw Zod path; the error banner stays after the item is removed
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio → Interfaces → navigation *Edit* → *Add nav item*, leave it unbound: the autosave answers with the raw issue "• navigation.1.objectName — Invalid input: expected string, received undefined".

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- *Add nav item* inserts a placeholder; while it has no target every autosave fails with the Zod path above.
- Removing the placeholder (hover trash icon), letting autosave succeed and clicking *Done* does **not** clear the banner.
- The resulting draft is identical to the published app, yet Changes lists it as `repair_desk · Update`.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`AppNavCanvas` (`app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppNavCanvas.tsx`) creates the placeholder as `{ id: navId, type: 'object' }` with no `objectName`. `doNavSave` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` filters out only entries **without** a `type` — its comment still describes the older placeholder shape — so the untargeted entry is sent.

## Expected

Unbound placeholders are kept client-side (or dropped) on save; the error state clears after a successful save; a no-op draft is not offered as a change.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Drop entries that have no target for their `type`; reset the error on save success; make the remove control reachable by keyboard (today it only appears on hover).

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *add nav item placeholder navigation objectName invalid input banner stale*: 7 hits (0 open, 7 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11196 (closed) — same nav-editor surface, untargeted/label-less entries; different defect (display, not save refusal)
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
